prompt.en: What is 13²?
prompt.hi: 13 ka square kitna hai?

prompt.en: Add the first 8 odd numbers: 1 + 3 + 5 + … + 15. Can you get it without adding one by one?
prompt.hi: Pehle 8 odd numbers jodo: 1 + 3 + 5 + … + 15. Ek-ek karke jode bina nikaal sakte ho?

challenges.hint: The first n odd numbers always add up to a square.

prompt.en: Before you multiply, predict the last digit of 47².
prompt.hi: Multiply karne se pehle guess karo: 47² ka last digit kya hoga?

prompt.en: A school wants a square courtyard of tiles using all of 1,000 tiles. Is that possible? If not, what is the fewest extra tiles needed to make a full square?
prompt.hi: School ek square courtyard banana chahta hai, poore 1,000 tiles se. Kya yeh ho sakta hai? Agar nahi, toh kam se kam kitne tiles aur chahiye poora square banane ke liye?

challenges.hint: Find the squares just below and just above 1,000.

prompt.en: How many non-square numbers lie between 12² and 13²?
prompt.hi: 12² aur 13² ke beech kitne aise numbers hain jo square nahi hain?

challenges.hint: 144 and 169; count the numbers strictly between them.

prompt.en: Find √324 using prime factorisation.
prompt.hi: Prime factorisation se √324 nikaalo.

prompt.en: Predict first, then check: is √(9 + 16) the same as √9 + √16?
prompt.hi: Pehle guess karo, phir check karo: kya √(9 + 16) aur √9 + √16 same hain?

prompt.en: A square plot of land has an area of 576 m². How long is each side?
prompt.hi: Ek square plot ka area 576 m² hai. Har side kitni lambi hai?

prompt.en: Neha wrote: √(36 + 64) = 6 + 8 = 14. Find her mistake and the correct answer.
prompt.hi: Neha ne likha: √(36 + 64) = 6 + 8 = 14. Galti dhoondho aur sahi answer batao.

challenges.hint: The root acts on the whole 100.

prompt.en: 49 square tiles are arranged into one big square. How many tiles long is each side, and how is that the square root?
prompt.hi: 49 square tiles se ek bada square banaya. Har side kitne tiles lambi hai, aur yeh square root kaise hai?

prompt.en: What is the smallest number you must multiply 180 by to get a perfect square? What is the square root of the result?
prompt.hi: 180 ko kam se kam kis number se multiply karein ki perfect square ban jaaye? Result ka square root kya hoga?

prompt.en: What is 6³?
prompt.hi: 6³ kitna hai?

prompt.en: Find ∛2,744 using prime factorisation.
prompt.hi: Prime factorisation se ∛2,744 nikaalo.

prompt.en: A cube is built from small unit cubes. If you double the length of its edge, predict how many times as many unit cubes you need.
prompt.hi: Ek cube chhote unit cubes se bana hai. Agar edge ki length double kar do, toh guess karo kitne guna zyada unit cubes lagenge?

prompt.en: Ludo dice are stacked into a big solid cube with 5 dice along each edge. How many dice are used?
prompt.hi: Ludo ke dice ek bade solid cube mein lagaye hain, har edge pe 5 dice. Kitne dice lage?

prompt.en: Is 500 a perfect cube? Explain using its prime factors, and say the smallest number to multiply it by to make one.
prompt.hi: Kya 500 perfect cube hai? Prime factors se samjhao, aur batao kis sabse chhote number se multiply karein toh perfect cube ban jaaye.

prompt.en: Without multiplying it all out, what is the last digit of 27³?
prompt.hi: Poora multiply kiye bina batao, 27³ ka last digit kya hoga?

prompt.en: Work out 1³ + 2³ + 3³. Is the total a perfect square?
prompt.hi: 1³ + 2³ + 3³ nikalo. Kya total ek perfect square hai?

prompt.en: {friendF} wrote: 3³ + 4³ = 7³ = 343. Check her work and give the correct total.
prompt.hi: {friendF} ne likha: 3³ + 4³ = 7³ = 343. Uska kaam check karo aur sahi total batao.

prompt.en: 1³ + 2³ + 3³ is a perfect square. Predict whether 1³ + 2³ + 3³ + 4³ is also a perfect square, then check. Which number is it the square of?
prompt.hi: 1³ + 2³ + 3³ ek perfect square hai. Predict karo ki 1³ + 2³ + 3³ + 4³ bhi perfect square hai ya nahi, phir check karo. Yeh kis number ka square hai?

prompt.en: What is 2⁵?
prompt.hi: 2⁵ kitna hai?

prompt.en: Meena says 3⁴ = 12. Is she right? What is the correct value?
prompt.hi: Meena kehti hai 3⁴ = 12. Kya woh sahi hai? Sahi value kya hai?

prompt.en: A sheet of paper is folded in half 10 times. Before working it out, predict: more or fewer than 100 layers?
prompt.hi: Ek kaagaz ko 10 baar aadha fold karte hain. Calculate karne se pehle guess karo: 100 layers se zyada ya kam?

prompt.en: A message is forwarded on a phone chain. In round 1, one person sends it to 3 people. In each next round, everyone who just got it sends it to 3 new people. How many people get it in round 4?
prompt.hi: Ek message phone chain mein forward hota hai. Round 1 mein ek insaan 3 logon ko bhejta hai. Har agle round mein jisne abhi paaya woh 3 naye logon ko bhejta hai. Round 4 mein kitne log message paayenge?

challenges.hint: Round 1: 3, round 2: 9; each round multiplies by 3.

prompt.en: Teach a younger student what the base and the exponent in 7³ mean, and what 7³ equals.
prompt.hi: Ek chhote student ko sikhao ki 7³ mein base aur exponent ka kya matlab hai, aur 7³ kitna hai.

challenges.hint: The base is repeated; the exponent counts the repeats.

prompt.en: How many zeros does 10⁵ have when written out, and what is it called in the Indian system?
prompt.hi: 10⁵ ko likhne pe kitne zeros aate hain, aur Indian system mein ise kya kehte hain?

challenges.hint: Each factor of 10 adds a zero.

prompt.en: Sonu simplified 2³ × 3² = 6⁵. Spot the mistake and give the correct value.
prompt.hi: Sonu ne 2³ × 3² = 6⁵ simplify kiya. Galti pakdo aur sahi value batao.

challenges.hint: The add-the-exponents rule needs the same base.

prompt.en: Compare a³ × a² and (a³)². Are they the same? Write each as a single power.
prompt.hi: a³ × a² aur (a³)² ko compare karo. Kya same hain? Dono ko single power mein likho.

prompt.en: Find 2⁴ × 5⁴ quickly without multiplying 16 by 625.
prompt.hi: 2⁴ × 5⁴ jaldi nikaalo, 16 ko 625 se multiply kiye bina.

prompt.en: What is 7⁰ + (−7)⁰?
prompt.hi: 7⁰ + (−7)⁰ kitna hai?

prompt.en: What is 2⁻³ as a fraction?
prompt.hi: 2⁻³ fraction mein kitna hai?

prompt.en: Pooja wrote 10⁻² = −100. What's the mistake? What is the correct value?
prompt.hi: Pooja ne likha 10⁻² = −100. Galti kya hai? Sahi value kya hai?

prompt.en: Write 6.02 × 10⁵ as an ordinary number.
prompt.hi: 6.02 × 10⁵ ko ordinary number mein likho.

challenges.hint: Move the point 5 places to the right.

prompt.en: What is (1/2)⁻¹?
prompt.hi: (1/2)⁻¹ kitna hai?

prompt.en: What number is XLIX?
prompt.hi: XLIX kaunsa number hai?

prompt.en: Rohit read IX on a chapter heading as 'chapter 11'. Was he right?
prompt.hi: Rohit ne chapter heading pe IX ko 'chapter 11' padha. Kya woh sahi tha?

challenges.hint: A smaller symbol before a bigger one is subtracted.

prompt.en: A book shows 'Chapter XIV'. Which chapter number is that?
prompt.hi: Ek kitaab mein 'Chapter XIV' likha hai. Yeh kaunsa chapter number hai?

prompt.en: Try to multiply XXIV by XII without changing to our digits. Then do 24 × 12 our way. What is the answer, and why is our way easier?
prompt.hi: XXIV ko XII se hamare digits mein badle bina multiply karke dekho. Phir 24 × 12 hamare tareeke se karo. Answer kya hai, aur hamara tareeka aasaan kyun hai?

prompt.en: Someone wrote 'five thousand thirty' as 530. What went wrong?
prompt.hi: Kisi ne 'five thousand thirty' ko 530 likha. Kya galat hua?

prompt.en: Convert 1011 (base 2) to base 10.
prompt.hi: 1011 (base 2) ko base 10 mein badlo.

prompt.en: Write 13 in base 2.
prompt.hi: 13 ko base 2 mein likho.

prompt.en: In base 5, we only have digits 0, 1, 2, 3, 4. Counting 1, 2, 3, 4 … predict what comes next.
prompt.hi: Base 5 mein sirf digits 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 hain. 1, 2, 3, 4 … ginte hue, guess karo agla kya aayega.

challenges.hint: When the ones column is full, we make a group.

prompt.en: Predict before drawing: in a long rectangle, do the diagonals meet at a right angle?
prompt.hi: Draw karne se pehle guess karo: lambe rectangle mein kya diagonals right angle pe milte hain?

challenges.hint: The diagonals become almost flat and cross at a narrow angle.

prompt.en: Tanu says: 'In a 6 cm by 4 cm rectangle, the diagonal cuts each corner into two 45° angles.' Is she right?
prompt.hi: Tanu kehti hai: '6 cm by 4 cm rectangle mein diagonal har corner ko do 45° angles mein kaatta hai.' Kya woh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Equal parts need the two sides at that corner to be equal.

prompt.en: A carpenter makes a door frame with opposite sides equal and measures the two diagonals: 205 cm and 208 cm. Is the frame a true rectangle?
prompt.hi: Ek carpenter ne door frame banaya jiski opposite sides barabar hain, aur dono diagonals naape: 205 cm aur 208 cm. Kya frame sahi rectangle hai?

challenges.hint: In a rectangle, both diagonals are equal.

prompt.en: Dev drew a quadrilateral with sides 8 cm, 5 cm, 8 cm and 5 cm in order, but one corner measures 100°. He says it is a rectangle because its opposite sides are equal. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Dev ne ek quadrilateral banaya jiski sides order mein 8 cm, 5 cm, 8 cm aur 5 cm hain, par ek corner 100° ka hai. Woh kehta hai yeh rectangle hai kyunki opposite sides barabar hain. Kya woh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: A rectangle needs equal opposite sides and also ___ angles.

prompt.en: In rectangle ABCD, AB = (3x − 4) cm, CD = (2x + 5) cm and BC = x cm. Find x and the perimeter of ABCD.
prompt.hi: Rectangle ABCD mein AB = (3x − 4) cm, CD = (2x + 5) cm aur BC = x cm hai. x aur ABCD ka perimeter nikalo.

challenges.hint: AB and CD are opposite, so 3x − 4 = 2x + 5.

prompt.en: Three angles of a quadrilateral are 80°, 95° and 100°. Find the fourth angle.
prompt.hi: Ek quadrilateral ke 3 angles 80°, 95° aur 100° hain. Chautha angle nikaalo.

prompt.en: A quadrilateral has three right angles. What is its fourth angle?
prompt.hi: Ek quadrilateral mein 3 right angles hain. Chautha angle kitna hai?

challenges.hint: Three right angles add up to how much?

prompt.en: Arjun put a dot inside a quadrilateral, joined it to the four corners and got 4 triangles. He wrote: angle sum = 4 × 180° = 720°. Find his mistake.
prompt.hi: Arjun ne quadrilateral ke andar ek dot lagaya, use chaaron corners se joda aur 4 triangles mile. Usne likha: angle sum = 4 × 180° = 720°. Galti dhoondho.

challenges.hint: The angles at the middle dot make a full turn.

prompt.en: A kite-shaped rangoli has two equal opposite angles of 110° each, and a third angle of 70°. What is the fourth angle?
prompt.hi: Ek kite ke shape ki rangoli mein do barabar opposite angles 110° ke hain, aur teesra angle 70° hai. Chautha angle kitna hai?

prompt.en: You tear off the four corners of a paper quadrilateral and fit them together at one point. What do you see, and what does it show?
prompt.hi: Tum kaagaz ke quadrilateral ke chaaron corners phaad ke ek point pe jodte ho. Kya dikhta hai, aur isse kya pata chalta hai?

challenges.hint: What angle is a full turn around a point?

prompt.en: A quadrilateral has angles x, x, 2x and 2x. Find x and all four angles.
prompt.hi: Ek quadrilateral ke angles x, x, 2x aur 2x hain. x aur chaaron angles nikaalo.

prompt.en: Using the same diagonal idea, what do the angles of a pentagon (5 sides) add up to?
prompt.hi: Isi diagonal wale idea se, pentagon (5 sides) ke angles kitne tak judte hain?

prompt.en: Quick recall: what is the sum of the angles of a quadrilateral?
prompt.hi: Jaldi yaad karo: quadrilateral ke angles ka sum kitna hota hai?

prompt.en: A rhombus has a side of 6 cm. What is its perimeter?
prompt.hi: Ek rhombus ki side 6 cm hai. Uska perimeter kitna hai?

prompt.en: A square and a 'diamond' rhombus are drawn side by side. Is the square also a rhombus? What is the only difference?
prompt.hi: Ek square aur ek 'diamond' rhombus saath mein bane hain. Kya square bhi rhombus hai? Fark sirf kya hai?

prompt.en: Predict before measuring: are the two diagonals of a slanted parallelogram equal?
prompt.hi: Naapne se pehle guess karo: kya slanted parallelogram ke dono diagonals barabar hote hain?

challenges.hint: One diagonal stretches long, the other gets short.

prompt.en: A kite has two sides of 5 cm and two sides of 8 cm. What is its perimeter, and which sides are next to each other?
prompt.hi: Ek kite ki do sides 5 cm aur do sides 8 cm ki hain. Perimeter kitna hai, aur kaunsi sides ek doosre ke paas hain?

challenges.hint: Equal sides are adjacent, sharing a corner.

prompt.en: Is 7,425 divisible by 9? Use the digit sum.
prompt.hi: Kya 7,425, 9 se divide hota hai? Digit sum use karo.

prompt.en: Is 3,516 divisible by 4?
prompt.hi: Kya 3,516, 4 se divide hota hai?

prompt.en: Is 9,163 divisible by 11? Use the alternating sum of the digits.
prompt.hi: Kya 9,163, 11 se divide hota hai? Digits ka alternating sum use karo.

prompt.en: {friendF} says: '135 has digit sum 9, so 135 is divisible by 6.' Check her reasoning.
prompt.hi: {friendF} kehti hai: '135 ka digit sum 9 hai, isliye 135, 6 se divide hota hai.' Uski reasoning check karo.

prompt.en: Vikram says 6,734 is divisible by 4 because it ends in 4. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Vikram kehta hai 6,734, 4 se divide hota hai kyunki end mein 4 hai. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: Predict, without dividing, whether 2,316 is divisible by 12. Then check.
prompt.hi: Divide kiye bina guess karo kya 2,316, 12 se divide hota hai. Phir check karo.

prompt.en: Is 5,24,136 divisible by 8?
prompt.hi: Kya 5,24,136, 8 se divide hota hai?

prompt.en: Show using place value that 342 = 3 × 99 + 4 × 9 + (3 + 4 + 2). What does this tell you about 342 and 9?
prompt.hi: Place value se dikhao ki 342 = 3 × 99 + 4 × 9 + (3 + 4 + 2). Isse 342 aur 9 ke baare mein kya pata chalta hai?

prompt.en: What digit goes in the blank so that 52_ is divisible by 9?
prompt.hi: 52_ mein khaali jagah pe kaunsa digit aaye ki number 9 se divide ho?

challenges.hint: What must the digit sum be a multiple of?

prompt.en: Is 61,809 divisible by 11? Use the alternating sum of the digits.
prompt.hi: Kya 61,809, 11 se divisible hai? Digits ka alternating sum use karo.

prompt.en: Ananya says: 'The digits of 4,236 add up to 15, which is divisible by 3, so 4,236 is divisible by 9 too.' Is she right?
prompt.hi: Ananya kehti hai: '4,236 ke digits ka sum 15 hai, jo 3 se divisible hai, isliye 4,236, 9 se bhi divisible hai.' Kya woh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: For 9, the digit sum itself must be a multiple of 9.

prompt.en: Two two-digit numbers are added and the answer has three digits. What must its hundreds digit be? Why?
prompt.hi: Do two-digit numbers jode aur answer 3 digit ka hai. Hundreds digit kya hona chahiye? Kyun?

prompt.en: In AB + AB = CD, can D be 7? Explain.
prompt.hi: AB + AB = CD mein, kya D, 7 ho sakta hai? Samjhao.

prompt.en: Find all pairs of different non-zero digits A > B with AB + BA = 121.
prompt.hi: Alag non-zero digits A > B ke saare pairs dhoondho jinke liye AB + BA = 121.

prompt.en: P and Q are different odd digits, and P + Q = RS is a two-digit number. Without solving, predict: can S be 5?
prompt.hi: P aur Q alag odd digits hain, aur P + Q = RS ek two-digit number hai. Bina solve kiye guess karo: kya S, 5 ho sakta hai?

prompt.en: Work out 23 × 102 in your head by splitting 102.
prompt.hi: 102 ko tod ke 23 × 102 mann mein nikaalo.

prompt.en: Before multiplying, predict how many products you get from (a + b)(c + d).
prompt.hi: Multiply karne se pehle guess karo, (a + b)(c + d) se kitne products milenge.

challenges.hint: Each of 2 terms meets each of 2 terms.

prompt.en: Find 99 × 45 mentally.
prompt.hi: 99 × 45 mann mein nikaalo.

prompt.en: Predict, then check: is (3 + 4)² equal to 3² + 4²?
prompt.hi: Guess karo, phir check karo: kya (3 + 4)², 3² + 4² ke barabar hai?

prompt.en: Find 99² mentally using an identity.
prompt.hi: Identity se 99² mann mein nikaalo.

prompt.en: Find 103 × 97 mentally.
prompt.hi: 103 × 97 mann mein nikaalo.

prompt.en: Find 51² − 49² without squaring either number.
prompt.hi: Kisi bhi number ka square kiye bina 51² − 49² nikaalo.

prompt.en: Find 21² using (a + b)².
prompt.hi: (a + b)² use karke 21² nikaalo.

prompt.en: If a − b = 4 and ab = 21, find a² + b².
prompt.hi: Agar a − b = 4 aur ab = 21 hai, to a² + b² nikalo.

prompt.en: Someone claims x² + 2x = 3x². Predict: will testing with x = 1 catch the mistake? Then try x = 2.
prompt.hi: Kisi ka dava hai x² + 2x = 3x². Guess karo: kya x = 1 se test karne pe galti pakdi jaayegi? Phir x = 2 try karo.

prompt.en: Neel wrote −(a − b) = −a − b. Is he right? Use a = 5, b = 2 to check.
prompt.hi: Neel ne likha −(a − b) = −a − b. Kya woh sahi hai? a = 5, b = 2 se check karo.

prompt.en: Simplify 5 − (2 + x) and 5 − 2 + x. Are they the same?
prompt.hi: 5 − (2 + x) aur 5 − 2 + x ko simplify karo. Kya dono same hain?

challenges.hint: The minus applies to the whole bracket.

prompt.en: A classmate simplified (a + 3)² − (a − 3)² as (a² + 9) − (a² − 9) = 18. Find the first wrong line and give the correct answer.
prompt.hi: Ek classmate ne (a + 3)² − (a − 3)² ko (a² + 9) − (a² − 9) = 18 simplify kiya. Pehli galat line dhoondho aur sahi answer do.

prompt.en: Rohan claims x² + x = 2x. He tests x = 0 (both sides 0) and x = 1 (both sides 2) and says it is proved. Is he right? Test x = 3.
prompt.hi: Rohan kehta hai x² + x = 2x. Usne x = 0 (dono sides 0) aur x = 1 (dono sides 2) test kiya aur kehta hai proof ho gaya. Kya woh sahi hai? x = 3 se test karo.

prompt.en: Write 12 : 18 in simplest form.
prompt.hi: 12 : 18 ko simplest form mein likho.

prompt.en: Ravi wanted twice as much chai, so he changed the recipe from milk : water = 2 : 3 to 4 : 5. Will it taste the same? Fix it.
prompt.hi: Ravi ko double chai chahiye thi, isliye usne recipe milk : water = 2 : 3 se 4 : 5 kar di. Kya taste same rahega? Theek karo.

challenges.hint: To keep the taste, both parts must be multiplied by the same number.

prompt.en: Find the ratio of 50 cm to 2 m in simplest form.
prompt.hi: 50 cm ka 2 m se ratio simplest form mein nikaalo.

prompt.en: Which of these are equivalent to 3 : 4? 6 : 8, 4 : 5, 9 : 12, 13 : 14
prompt.hi: Inmein se kaun 3 : 4 ke barabar hain? 6 : 8, 4 : 5, 9 : 12, 13 : 14

challenges.hint: For each pair: what times 3 gives the first term? Does the same number times 4 give the second?

prompt.en: Why is 4 : 6 the same ratio as 2 : 3, but 4 : 5 is not?
prompt.hi: 4 : 6, 2 : 3 ke barabar kyun hai, par 4 : 5 kyun nahi?

challenges.hint: How many times is the second term of 2 : 3 compared with the first?

prompt.en: A class has 18 girls and 24 boys. Write girls : boys and girls : whole class in simplest form.
prompt.hi: Ek class mein 18 ladkiyan aur 24 ladke hain. Girls : boys aur girls : poori class simplest form mein likho.

prompt.en: Simplify 45 : 60.
prompt.hi: 45 : 60 simplify karo.

prompt.en: A basket has 5 mangoes and 8 apples. Meenu says the ratio of apples to mangoes is 5 : 8. Is she right?
prompt.hi: Ek tokri mein 5 aam aur 8 seb hain. Meenu kehti hai seb ka aam se ratio 5 : 8 hai. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: 5 litres of petrol cost ₹525. What does 1 litre cost?
prompt.hi: 5 litre petrol ₹525 ka hai. 1 litre kitne ka hai?

challenges.hint: Divide the cost by the number of litres.

prompt.en: At that rate, what do 8 litres cost?
prompt.hi: Usi rate se 8 litre kitne ke honge?

prompt.en: 12 rotis need 300 g of atta. How much atta for 20 rotis?
prompt.hi: 12 rotiyon ke liye 300 g atta lagta hai. 20 rotiyon ke liye kitna atta?

prompt.en: A car goes 180 km on 12 litres. Sonal wrote: mileage = 12 ÷ 180 = 0.067 km per litre. What went wrong?
prompt.hi: Ek car 12 litre mein 180 km chalti hai. Sonal ne likha: mileage = 12 ÷ 180 = 0.067 km per litre. Kya galat hua?

challenges.hint: Divide the distance by the litres.

prompt.en: 6 notebooks cost ₹270. What does one cost?
prompt.hi: 6 notebooks ₹270 ki hain. Ek kitne ki hai?

prompt.en: Convert 3.5 km to metres.
prompt.hi: 3.5 km ko metre mein badlo.

prompt.en: Convert 2,750 g to kg.
prompt.hi: 2,750 g ko kg mein badlo.

challenges.hint: kg is the bigger unit, so divide by 1000.

prompt.en: Ankit wrote 450 cm = 45,000 m. What went wrong? Give the correct answer.
prompt.hi: Ankit ne likha 450 cm = 45,000 m. Kya galat hua? Sahi answer batao.

challenges.hint: Metres are bigger, so there should be fewer of them.

prompt.en: Convert 72 km/h to m/s.
prompt.hi: 72 km/h ko m/s mein badlo.

prompt.en: Before converting 6.2 km to metres, predict: will the answer be a bigger or smaller number than 6.2?
prompt.hi: 6.2 km ko metre mein badalne se pehle guess karo: answer 6.2 se bada number hoga ya chhota?

challenges.hint: You need many metres to make one km.

prompt.en: 1 m = 100 cm. Is 1 m² = 100 cm² too? Explain.
prompt.hi: 1 m = 100 cm. Kya 1 m² = 100 cm² bhi hai? Samjhao.

prompt.en: A Vande Bharat train runs at 108 km/h. What is that in m/s?
prompt.hi: Ek Vande Bharat train 108 km/h pe chal rahi hai. Yeh m/s mein kitna hai?

prompt.en: A 200 m long train runs at 72 km/h. How many seconds does it take to pass a signal pole?
prompt.hi: 200 m lambi train 72 km/h pe chal rahi hai. Signal ke khambhe ko paar karne mein kitne second lagenge?

prompt.en: Use a ratio table with 1 L = 1000 mL to convert 2.4 L to mL.
prompt.hi: 1 L = 1000 mL wali ratio table se 2.4 L ko mL mein badlo.

prompt.en: Convert 2.5 m² to cm².
prompt.hi: 2.5 m² ko cm² mein badlo.

prompt.en: Write 3/4 as a percentage.
prompt.hi: 3/4 ko percentage mein likho.

prompt.en: Kavya scored 60 out of 80 in a test. What is her percentage?
prompt.hi: Kavya ke test mein 80 mein se 60 marks aaye. Uska percentage kya hai?

prompt.en: Write 0.07 as a percentage.
prompt.hi: 0.07 ko percentage mein likho.

prompt.en: Raj wrote 0.5 = 5%. Is that right?
prompt.hi: Raj ne likha 0.5 = 5%. Kya yeh sahi hai?

prompt.en: A plant was 20 cm tall and is now 50 cm. Predict: is its new height more or less than 100% of its old height? Then find it.
prompt.hi: Ek paudha 20 cm ka tha aur ab 50 cm ka hai. Guess karo: nayi height purani ki 100% se zyada hai ya kam? Phir nikaalo.

prompt.en: A school cricket team won 9 of its 12 matches. What percentage did it win?
prompt.hi: School cricket team ne 12 mein se 9 match jeete. Kitne percent jeete?

prompt.en: A school had 400 students in 2025 and 460 in 2026. Write the 2026 number as a percentage of the 2025 number.
prompt.hi: Ek school mein 2025 mein 400 aur 2026 mein 460 students the. 2026 ki sankhya ko 2025 ki sankhya ke percentage mein likho.

prompt.en: Explain to a classmate how to change 3/8 into a percentage.
prompt.hi: Classmate ko samjhao ki 3/8 ko percentage mein kaise badalte hain.

challenges.hint: Out of 100, so multiply the fraction by 100.

prompt.en: Find 20% of 50.
prompt.hi: 50 ka 20% nikaalo.

prompt.en: A restaurant bill is ₹800 before GST. GST is 18%. How much GST is added, and what is the total bill?
prompt.hi: Restaurant ka bill GST se pehle ₹800 hai. GST 18% hai. Kitna GST juda, aur total bill kitna hai?

prompt.en: 30 is 20% of what number?
prompt.hi: 30 kis number ka 20% hai?

prompt.en: Asked '30 is 20% of what?', Kunal worked out 20% of 30 = 6. What went wrong?
prompt.hi: '30 kis number ka 20% hai?' poochhne pe Kunal ne 30 ka 20% = 6 nikaala. Kya galat hua?

challenges.hint: 30 is only a part, so the whole is bigger.

prompt.en: Use a bar of 10 equal blocks to find 40% of 60.
prompt.hi: 10 barabar blocks ke bar se 60 ka 40% nikaalo.

prompt.en: Meera has saved ₹450 for a cycle. That is 15% of the cycle's price. What is the price?
prompt.hi: Meera ne cycle ke liye ₹450 bachaaye hain. Yeh cycle ki keemat ka 15% hai. Cycle ki keemat kya hai?

prompt.en: 45 out of 60 students passed. What percentage passed?
prompt.hi: 60 mein se 45 students pass hue. Kitne percent pass hue?

prompt.en: Find 5% of ₹1,200.
prompt.hi: ₹1,200 ka 5% nikaalo.

prompt.en: A ₹500 school bag's price goes up by 10%. What is the new price?
prompt.hi: ₹500 ke school bag ki keemat 10% badh gayi. Nayi keemat kya hai?

prompt.en: Uncle's weight went from 80 kg to 68 kg. What is the percentage decrease?
prompt.hi: Chacha ji ka wazan 80 kg se 68 kg ho gaya. Kitne percent kam hua?

prompt.en: A shopkeeper buys a fan for ₹400 and sells it for ₹460. Find the profit percentage.
prompt.hi: Ek dukaandaar ₹400 mein pankha kharidta hai aur ₹460 mein bechta hai. Profit percentage nikaalo.

prompt.en: A ₹100 toy's price goes up 20%, then down 20%. Predict: will it be back to ₹100? Then work it out.
prompt.hi: ₹100 ke khilone ki keemat 20% badhti hai, phir 20% ghat-ti hai. Guess karo: kya wapas ₹100 hogi? Phir nikaalo.

prompt.en: A ₹2,000 kurta has 25% off, then an extra 10% off at the counter. What is the final price?
prompt.hi: ₹2,000 ke kurte pe 25% off hai, phir counter pe extra 10% off. Final keemat kya hai?

prompt.en: Dev bought a phone cover for ₹400 and sold it for ₹500. He says profit = 100 ÷ 500 = 20%. What's wrong?
prompt.hi: Dev ne ₹400 mein phone cover kharida aur ₹500 mein becha. Woh kehta hai profit = 100 ÷ 500 = 20%. Kya galat hai?

prompt.en: A town has 50,000 people. The population grows 10% each year. What will it be after 2 years?
prompt.hi: Ek shahar mein 50,000 log hain. Har saal aabaadi 10% badhti hai. 2 saal baad kitni hogi?

prompt.en: Explain to a friend why '30% off plus 10% off' is not 40% off.
prompt.hi: Dost ko samjhao ki '30% off plus 10% off', 40% off kyun nahi hai.

prompt.en: A ₹250 item is reduced by 8%. What is the new price?
prompt.hi: ₹250 ki cheez 8% kam ho gayi. Nayi keemat kya hai?

prompt.en: Predict: if you double the side of a square, how many times bigger does the area get?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: agar square ki side double kar do, toh area kitne guna bada hoga?

challenges.hint: Count how many 1 by 1 squares fit inside the 2 by 2 square.

prompt.en: A square has area 25 cm². What is the area of the square drawn on its diagonal?
prompt.hi: Ek square ka area 25 cm² hai. Uske diagonal pe bane square ka area kitna hai?

prompt.en: Two ways to make a 'smaller' square inside a square of side 4 cm: (a) a 2 cm square in a corner; (b) join the midpoints of the sides. Which gives half the area?
prompt.hi: 4 cm side wale square ke andar 'chhota' square banane ke do tareeke: (a) corner mein 2 cm ka square; (b) sides ke midpoints jodo. Kaunsa aadha area deta hai?

challenges.hint: 4 cm² out of 16 cm², a quarter.

options.text: (a) a 2 cm square in a corner
(b) join the midpoints of the sides. Which gives half the area

challenges.keyText: (b) join the midpoints of the sides. Which gives half the area

prompt.en: A floor tile is 30 cm by 30 cm. A bigger tile is 60 cm by 60 cm. How many small tiles cover the same area as one big tile?
prompt.hi: Ek floor tile 30 cm by 30 cm hai. Ek badi tile 60 cm by 60 cm hai. Ek badi tile ke barabar area ke liye kitni chhoti tiles lagengi?

prompt.en: A square has area 18 cm². You join the midpoints of its sides. What is the area of the inner square?
prompt.hi: Ek square ka area 18 cm² hai. Tum uski sides ke midpoints jodte ho. Andar wale square ka area kitna hai?

prompt.en: If the side of a square is made 3 times longer, how many times bigger is the area?
prompt.hi: Agar square ki side 3 guna lambi kar di jaaye, toh area kitne guna bada hoga?

prompt.en: A square school courtyard has side 10 m. Rani marks the midpoint of each side and joins them to make a square flower bed inside. What is the area of the flower bed?
prompt.hi: School ka ek square courtyard hai jiski side 10 m hai. Rani har side ka midpoint mark karke unhe jodti hai, aur andar ek square flower bed banta hai. Flower bed ka area kitna hai?

challenges.hint: The inner square has exactly half the area of the outer square.

prompt.en: The two shorter sides of a right triangle are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse.
prompt.hi: Right triangle ki do chhoti sides 6 cm aur 8 cm hain. Hypotenuse nikaalo.

prompt.en: A right triangle has hypotenuse 13 cm and one side 5 cm. Find the other side.
prompt.hi: Ek right triangle ka hypotenuse 13 cm aur ek side 5 cm hai. Doosri side nikaalo.

prompt.en: A 10 m ladder leans against a wall with its foot 6 m from the wall. How high up the wall does it reach?
prompt.hi: 10 m ki seedhi deewar se tiki hai, uska pair deewar se 6 m door hai. Seedhi deewar pe kitni oonchai tak pahunchti hai?

prompt.en: For a right triangle with hypotenuse 25 cm and one side 7 cm, Jay wrote: other side = √(625 + 49) = √674. Find his mistake and the correct answer.
prompt.hi: Hypotenuse 25 cm aur ek side 7 cm wale right triangle ke liye Jay ne likha: doosri side = √(625 + 49) = √674. Galti dhoondho aur sahi answer batao.

challenges.hint: Since 25 is the hypotenuse, subtract its partner's square.

prompt.en: A triangle has sides 5 cm, 6 cm and 7 cm. Predict: is it right-angled? Then check.
prompt.hi: Ek triangle ki sides 5 cm, 6 cm aur 7 cm hain. Guess karo: kya yeh right-angled hai? Phir check karo.

prompt.en: Meena says the hypotenuse of a right triangle with shorter sides 3 cm and 4 cm is 7 cm. What's wrong?
prompt.hi: Meena kehti hai 3 cm aur 4 cm chhoti sides wale right triangle ka hypotenuse 7 cm hai. Kya galat hai?

challenges.hint: Then the triangle would be flat; square the sides instead.

prompt.en: A rectangular field is 40 m by 30 m. How much shorter is walking along the diagonal than walking along two sides?
prompt.hi: Ek rectangular khet 40 m by 30 m hai. Do sides ke saath chalne ke bajaye diagonal pe chalna kitna chhota hai?

prompt.en: Kunal says: 'A triangle with all angles 60° and two sides of 4 cm has third side √(16 + 16) ≈ 5.66 cm.' What is wrong?
prompt.hi: Kunal kehta hai: 'Saare angles 60° aur do sides 4 cm wale triangle ki teesri side √(16 + 16) ≈ 5.66 cm hai.' Kya galat hai?

prompt.en: Find the hypotenuse of a right triangle with shorter sides 9 cm and 12 cm.
prompt.hi: 9 cm aur 12 cm chhoti sides wale right triangle ka hypotenuse nikaalo.

prompt.en: A triangle has sides 9 cm, 40 cm and 41 cm. Is it right-angled?
prompt.hi: Ek triangle ki sides 9 cm, 40 cm aur 41 cm hain. Kya yeh right-angled hai?

prompt.en: A mason checks the corner of a room. He marks 60 cm along one wall and 80 cm along the other, then measures 99 cm between the two marks. Is the corner a right angle? What should the distance be for a right angle?
prompt.hi: Ek mistri kamre ka corner check karta hai. Woh ek deewar par 60 cm aur doosri par 80 cm mark karta hai, phir dono marks ke beech 99 cm naapta hai. Kya corner right angle hai? Right angle ke liye distance kitna hona chahiye?

challenges.hint: If the corner is 90°, the 99 cm line is the hypotenuse.

prompt.en: A triangle has sides 2.5 cm, 6.5 cm and 6 cm. Kabir compares 2.5² + 6.5² with 6², finds they differ, and says it is not right-angled. Is he correct?
prompt.hi: Ek triangle ki sides 2.5 cm, 6.5 cm aur 6 cm hain. Kabir ne 2.5² + 6.5² ko 6² se compare kiya, alag aaye, aur bola yeh right-angled nahi hai. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: Is 6, 8, 10 a Pythagorean triple?
prompt.hi: Kya 6, 8, 10 Pythagorean triple hai?

prompt.en: Is 8, 15, 17 a Pythagorean triple?
prompt.hi: Kya 8, 15, 17 Pythagorean triple hai?

prompt.en: 3, 4, 5 is a triple. Predict whether 30, 40, 50 is a triple, then check.
prompt.hi: 3, 4, 5 ek triple hai. Guess karo kya 30, 40, 50 bhi triple hai, phir check karo.

prompt.en: Chirag says: '3, 4, 5 is a triple, so if I add 1 to each, 4, 5, 6 is a triple too.' Check his claim.
prompt.hi: Chirag kehta hai: '3, 4, 5 triple hai, toh har ek mein 1 jodne se 4, 5, 6 bhi triple hoga.' Uska dava check karo.

prompt.en: Lata tested 13, 5, 12 as 13² + 5² = 194, which isn't 12² = 144, and said 'not a triple'. What did she do wrong?
prompt.hi: Lata ne 13, 5, 12 ko 13² + 5² = 194 se test kiya, jo 12² = 144 nahi hai, aur bola 'triple nahi hai'. Usne kya galat kiya?

prompt.en: Is 5, 12, 13 a Pythagorean triple?
prompt.hi: Kya 5, 12, 13 Pythagorean triple hai?

prompt.en: On a map, 1 cm stands for 5 km. Two villages are 7 cm apart on the map. How far apart are they really?
prompt.hi: Map pe 1 cm ka matlab 5 km hai. Do gaon map pe 7 cm door hain. Asal mein kitne door hain?

prompt.en: A map has scale 1 : 50,000. Two towns are 4 cm apart on it. How far apart are they in km?
prompt.hi: Ek map ka scale 1 : 50,000 hai. Do shehar us pe 4 cm door hain. Asal mein kitne km door hain?

prompt.en: On a map, 1 cm stands for 20 km. Two cities are 130 km apart. How far apart should they be on the map?
prompt.hi: Map pe 1 cm ka matlab 20 km hai. Do shehar 130 km door hain. Map pe kitne door dikhane chahiye?

prompt.en: Which of these is equivalent to 2 : 3 : 5? 4 : 6 : 10, 4 : 6 : 5, 4 : 5 : 7
prompt.hi: Inmein se kaun 2 : 3 : 5 ke barabar hai? 4 : 6 : 10, 4 : 6 : 5, 4 : 5 : 7

challenges.hint: Divide each term of an option by the matching term of 2 : 3 : 5. Do all three give the same number?

prompt.en: Ages of A : B are 2 : 3, and B : C are 4 : 5. Find A : B : C.
prompt.hi: A : B ki umar 2 : 3 hai, aur B : C ki 4 : 5. A : B : C nikaalo.

challenges.hint: Find the smallest number both 3 and 4 go into. Scale each ratio so B becomes that number.

prompt.en: A scale bar shows 1 cm = 2 km. How long on the map is a 9 km road?
prompt.hi: Scale bar dikhata hai 1 cm = 2 km. 9 km ki sadak map pe kitni lambi hogi?

prompt.en: Simplify 6 : 9 : 15.
prompt.hi: 6 : 9 : 15 simplify karo.

prompt.en: On a district map, 1 cm stands for 4 km. Two towns are 36 km apart by road. How long is the road on the map?
prompt.hi: District ke map par 1 cm ka matlab 4 km hai. Do towns road se 36 km door hain. Map par road kitni lambi hogi?

prompt.en: A railway map has scale 1 : 50,000. The line between two stations is 7.5 km long. How long is it on the map?
prompt.hi: Railway map ka scale 1 : 50,000 hai. Do stations ke beech line 7.5 km lambi hai. Map par woh kitni lambi hogi?

prompt.en: {friendF} draws her school campus at a scale of 1 : 2,000. The campus is 450 m long and 520 m wide. What size is it on the map, and will it fit on a 20 cm × 30 cm sheet?
prompt.hi: {friendF} apne school campus ka map 1 : 2,000 scale par banati hai. Campus 450 m lamba aur 520 m chauda hai. Map par uska size kya hoga, aur kya woh 20 cm × 30 cm sheet par fit hoga?

prompt.en: 64 sweets are shared in the ratio 3 : 5. Predict: is the bigger share more than half? Then find both shares.
prompt.hi: 64 mithaaiyan 3 : 5 mein baanti gayi. Guess karo: kya bada hissa aadhe se zyada hai? Phir dono hisse nikaalo.

prompt.en: In the ratio 2 : 3, does the first person get 2/3 of the total or 2/5? Show with ₹50.
prompt.hi: Ratio 2 : 3 mein, pehle insaan ko total ka 2/3 milta hai ya 2/5? ₹50 se dikhao.

prompt.en: Mangoes are shared between {friendF} and Bina in the ratio 4 : 5. Bina gets 35. How many mangoes were there in all?
prompt.hi: Aam {friendF} aur Bina mein 4 : 5 mein baante gaye. Bina ko 35 mile. Kul kitne aam the?

prompt.en: A family's monthly budget is ₹20,000, of which ₹8,000 goes on food. What angle should food get in a pie chart?
prompt.hi: Ek parivaar ka mahine ka budget ₹20,000 hai, jismein ₹8,000 khaane pe jaata hai. Pie chart mein khaane ko kitna angle milega?

prompt.en: In a pie chart for 30 students, the 'walk to school' sector is 72°. How many students walk?
prompt.hi: 30 students ke pie chart mein 'paidal school' sector 72° ka hai. Kitne students paidal aate hain?

prompt.en: Neha drew the 25% sector of her pie chart with an angle of 25°. Correct her.
prompt.hi: Neha ne pie chart ka 25% wala sector 25° ka banaya. Use theek karo.

prompt.en: Predict: if one item is exactly half of the data, what angle is its sector?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: agar ek cheez data ka bilkul aadha hai, toh uska sector kitne angle ka hoga?

prompt.en: What sector angle shows 10% of the data?
prompt.hi: Data ka 10% dikhane wala sector angle kitna hai?

prompt.en: 4 workers build a wall in 12 days. How many days would 6 workers take at the same rate?
prompt.hi: 4 mazdoor 12 din mein deewar banate hain. Usi speed se 6 mazdoor kitne din lenge?

prompt.en: Gopal says: '4 workers take 12 days, so 8 workers take 24 days.' What's wrong?
prompt.hi: Gopal kehta hai: '4 mazdoor 12 din lete hain, toh 8 mazdoor 24 din lenge.' Kya galat hai?

prompt.en: A car covers a 120 km trip in 3 hours at 40 km/h. How long at 60 km/h?
prompt.hi: Ek car 120 km ka safar 40 km/h pe 3 ghante mein karti hai. 60 km/h pe kitna samay lagega?

prompt.en: Food in a hostel lasts 150 students for 30 days. If 30 more students join, how long will it last?
prompt.hi: Hostel ka khaana 150 students ke liye 30 din chalta hai. Agar 30 aur students aa jaayein, toh kitne din chalega?

prompt.en: Isha says: '4 workers take 12 days, so 6 workers (2 more) take 10 days (2 fewer).' Check her answer.
prompt.hi: Isha kehti hai: '4 mazdoor 12 din lete hain, toh 6 mazdoor (2 zyada) 10 din (2 kam) lenge.' Uska answer check karo.

prompt.en: Identical pipes fill a tank. Are the number of pipes and the time to fill the tank inversely proportional?
prompt.hi: Ek jaise pipes ek tank bhar rahe hain. Kya pipes ki sankhya aur tank bharne ka samay inversely proportional hain?

challenges.hint: Each pipe does half as much.

prompt.en: x: 1, 2, 3, 4 and y: 10, 8, 6, 4. y goes down as x goes up. Is y inversely proportional to x?
prompt.hi: x: 1, 2, 3, 4 aur y: 10, 8, 6, 4. x badhta hai toh y ghat-ta hai. Kya y, x ke inversely proportional hai?

prompt.en: 6 taps fill a tank in 8 hours. How long would 4 taps take?
prompt.hi: 6 nal ek tank 8 ghante mein bharte hain. 4 nal kitna samay lenge?

prompt.en: The Sierpinski triangle has 3 shaded triangles at stage 1. How many at stage 2?
prompt.hi: Sierpinski triangle mein stage 1 pe 3 shaded triangles hain. Stage 2 pe kitne?

prompt.en: Predict: at stage 4, will the Sierpinski triangle have more or fewer than 50 shaded triangles? Then find the number.
prompt.hi: Guess karo: stage 4 pe Sierpinski triangle mein 50 se zyada shaded triangles honge ya kam? Phir number nikaalo.

prompt.en: A tree trunk splits into 2 branches, and every new branch splits into 2 again. After 5 rounds of splitting, how many newest branches are there?
prompt.hi: Ek ped ka tana 2 shaakhaon mein batta hai, aur har nayi shaakha phir 2 mein batti hai. 5 baar batne ke baad sabse nayi kitni shaakhaen hongi?

prompt.en: At stage 3 of the Sierpinski triangle, how many shaded triangles are there, and what fraction of the area is shaded?
prompt.hi: Sierpinski triangle ki stage 3 pe kitne shaded triangles hain, aur area ka kitna hissa shaded hai?

prompt.en: Six squares are joined in one straight row. Predict: will it fold into a cube?
prompt.hi: Chhe squares ek seedhi line mein jude hain. Guess karo: kya yeh cube mein fold hoga?

challenges.hint: The loop covers 4 sides; the top and bottom are open.

prompt.en: Can a polyhedron have 7 faces, 8 vertices and 12 edges? Use Euler's formula.
prompt.hi: Kya kisi polyhedron ke 7 faces, 8 vertices aur 12 edges ho sakte hain? Euler ka formula use karo.

prompt.en: Sahil counted the edges of a cube as 6 faces × 4 edges = 24. What did he miss?
prompt.hi: Sahil ne cube ke edges 6 faces × 4 edges = 24 gine. Usse kya chhoot gaya?

prompt.en: What is F + V − E for a polyhedron such as a cube or a pyramid?
prompt.hi: Cube ya pyramid jaise polyhedron ke liye F + V − E kitna hota hai?

prompt.en: Find the mean of 6, 8, 7, 9 and 5.
prompt.hi: 6, 8, 7, 9 aur 5 ka mean nikaalo.

prompt.en: Find the mean of 12, 15, 18, 21 and 9.
prompt.hi: 12, 15, 18, 21 aur 9 ka mean nikaalo.

prompt.en: Arjun said the mean of 3, 9, 4, 10, 4 is 4 because it's the middle number after sorting. Is he right?
prompt.hi: Arjun ne kaha 3, 9, 4, 10, 4 ka mean 4 hai kyunki sort karne ke baad beech mein yahi hai. Kya woh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Add everything, then divide by how many.

prompt.en: The mean of four numbers is 15. Three of them are 12, 18 and 10. Find the fourth.
prompt.hi: Chaar numbers ka mean 15 hai. Unmein se 3 12, 18 aur 10 hain. Chautha nikaalo.

prompt.en: The noon temperatures in a week were 28, 30, 31, 29, 32, 30 and 30 °C. Find the mean temperature.
prompt.hi: Ek hafte mein dopahar ka taapmaan 28, 30, 31, 29, 32, 30 aur 30 °C tha. Mean taapmaan nikaalo.

prompt.en: A batter has an average of 40 runs over 9 innings. How many must she score in the 10th innings to raise her average to 42?
prompt.hi: Ek batter ka 9 innings mein average 40 runs hai. 10th innings mein kitne run banaye ki average 42 ho jaaye?

prompt.en: Three towers have 3, 7 and 5 blocks. Move blocks so all towers are the same height. How tall is each, and what does that number mean?
prompt.hi: 3 towers mein 3, 7 aur 5 blocks hain. Blocks hilaa ke sabko barabar oonchai ka karo. Har ek kitna ooncha hai, aur yeh number kya hai?

challenges.hint: How many blocks are there in all?

prompt.en: Isha says the mean of 1, 2, 4, 5 can't be 3 because 3 isn't one of the numbers. Is she right?
prompt.hi: Isha kehti hai 1, 2, 4, 5 ka mean 3 nahi ho sakta kyunki 3 inmein se koi number nahi hai. Kya woh sahi hai?

prompt.en: Find the mean of 10, 20, 30 and 40.
prompt.hi: 10, 20, 30 aur 40 ka mean nikaalo.

prompt.en: A line graph shows a child's height: age 8: 125 cm, 9: 129 cm, 10: 136 cm, 11: 141 cm. How much did the child grow from age 10 to 11?
prompt.hi: Ek line graph bachche ki height dikhata hai: 8 saal: 125 cm, 9: 129 cm, 10: 136 cm, 11: 141 cm. 10 se 11 saal mein kitna badha?

prompt.en: A graph of a child's height uses a vertical axis starting at 120 cm. The line from 121 cm to 125 cm looks huge. What's misleading, and what's the real change?
prompt.hi: Ek bachche ki height ke graph ka vertical axis 120 cm se shuru hota hai. 121 cm se 125 cm ki line bahut badi dikhti hai. Kya gumraah karne wala hai, aur asli badlaav kitna hai?

prompt.en: Using the same trick (double, add 6, halve, subtract your number), predict the answer if you start with 100.
prompt.hi: Usi trick se (double, 6 jodo, aadha, apna number ghataao) guess karo agar 100 se shuru karo toh answer kya aayega.

challenges.hint: Run 100 through the steps one at a time. Double it first.

prompt.en: n² + n + 41 gives a prime number for n = 0, 1, 2, … up to 39. Is it always prime? Try n = 40.
prompt.hi: n² + n + 41, n = 0, 1, 2, … 39 tak prime number deta hai. Kya yeh hamesha prime hai? n = 40 try karo.

prompt.en: Write an expression for: subtract 2 from a number, then multiply by 4.
prompt.hi: Expression likho: ek number mein se 2 ghataao, phir 4 se multiply karo.

prompt.en: Predict: if the middle bottom brick of a 3-row pyramid goes up by 1, how much does the top go up?
prompt.hi: Guess karo: agar 3-row pyramid ki beech wali neeche ki brick 1 badhe, toh top kitna badhega?

prompt.en: A 3-row pyramid has bottom bricks 4, ?, 6 and a top of 30. Find the missing brick.
prompt.hi: Ek 3-row pyramid ki neeche ki bricks 4, ?, 6 hain aur top 30 hai. Missing brick nikaalo.

prompt.en: Solve the pyramid with bottom bricks ★, 2, 5 and top 20, once using ★ and once using x. Does the symbol matter?
prompt.hi: Neeche ki bricks ★, 2, 5 aur top 20 wala pyramid solve karo, ek baar ★ se aur ek baar x se. Kya symbol se fark padta hai?

prompt.en: Bottom bricks 6, 1, 4. Find the top.
prompt.hi: Neeche ki bricks 6, 1, 4. Top nikaalo.

prompt.en: A parallelogram has base 9 cm and perpendicular height 4 cm. Find its area.
prompt.hi: Ek parallelogram ka base 9 cm aur perpendicular height 4 cm hai. Area nikaalo.

prompt.en: A triangle has base 10 cm and height 6 cm. Find its area.
prompt.hi: Ek triangle ka base 10 cm aur height 6 cm hai. Area nikaalo.

challenges.hint: Half a parallelogram with the same base and height.

prompt.en: A parallelogram has base 8 cm, slanting side 5 cm and height 4 cm. Mohan says its area is 8 × 5 = 40 cm². Fix it.
prompt.hi: Ek parallelogram ka base 8 cm, tircha side 5 cm aur height 4 cm hai. Mohan kehta hai area 8 × 5 = 40 cm² hai. Theek karo.

challenges.hint: Is the 5 cm side standing straight up from the base?

prompt.en: You cut a triangle off one end of a parallelogram and stick it on the other end to make a rectangle. Predict: is the area bigger, smaller or the same?
prompt.hi: Tum parallelogram ke ek siron se triangle kaat ke doosre sire pe chipka dete ho, rectangle ban jaata hai. Guess karo: area bada hoga, chhota ya same?

prompt.en: A slanted parking slot is a parallelogram. Its edge along the kerb is 2.5 m and its perpendicular depth is 5 m. What area does it cover?
prompt.hi: Ek tirchha parking slot parallelogram hai. Footpath ke saath wala kinara 2.5 m aur seedhi gehraai 5 m hai. Kitna area gherta hai?

prompt.en: Pinky says a triangle with base 12 cm and height 5 cm has area 60 cm². What did she forget?
prompt.hi: Pinky kehti hai 12 cm base aur 5 cm height wale triangle ka area 60 cm² hai. Woh kya bhool gayi?

challenges.hint: The parallelogram made of two such triangles.

prompt.en: A parallelogram has sides 10 cm and 6 cm. The height onto the 10 cm side is 4.8 cm. What is the height onto the 6 cm side?
prompt.hi: Ek parallelogram ki sides 10 cm aur 6 cm hain. 10 cm side pe height 4.8 cm hai. 6 cm side pe height kitni hai?

prompt.en: An obtuse triangle has base 6 cm. Its height, drawn from the top vertex to the base extended outside the triangle, is 4 cm. Find its area and describe where the height is.
prompt.hi: Ek obtuse triangle ka base 6 cm hai. Upar ke vertex se base ko bahar badha kar giraayi height 4 cm hai. Area nikaalo aur batao height kahan hai.

challenges.hint: Does the height have to be inside the triangle?

prompt.en: Find the area of a triangle with base 8 cm and height 7 cm.
prompt.hi: 8 cm base aur 7 cm height wale triangle ka area nikaalo.

prompt.en: A parallelogram has sides 10 cm and 5 cm. The height onto the 5 cm side is 8 cm, and the height onto the 10 cm side is 4 cm. Ravi says the area is 10 × 8 = 80 cm². Is he right? Find the area.
prompt.hi: Ek parallelogram ki sides 10 cm aur 5 cm hain. 5 cm wali side par height 8 cm hai, aur 10 cm wali side par height 4 cm hai. Ravi kehta hai area 10 × 8 = 80 cm² hai. Kya woh sahi hai? Area nikalo.

challenges.hint: The 8 cm height belongs to the 5 cm side, and the 4 cm height to the 10 cm side.

prompt.en: A trapezium has parallel sides 8 cm and 12 cm, and height 5 cm. Find its area.
prompt.hi: Ek trapezium ki parallel sides 8 cm aur 12 cm hain, aur height 5 cm. Area nikaalo.

prompt.en: A field is a trapezium with parallel sides 30 m and 50 m, which are 20 m apart. Find its area.
prompt.hi: Ek khet trapezium hai jiski parallel sides 30 m aur 50 m hain, 20 m ki doori pe. Area nikaalo.

prompt.en: For a trapezium with parallel sides 8 cm and 12 cm and height 5 cm, Tina wrote (8 + 12) × 5 = 100 cm². Fix it.
prompt.hi: 8 cm aur 12 cm parallel sides aur 5 cm height wale trapezium ke liye Tina ne (8 + 12) × 5 = 100 cm² likha. Theek karo.

challenges.hint: The parallelogram made of two trapeziums.

prompt.en: An L-shaped room can be split into two rectangles in two different ways. Predict: will both ways give the same area?
prompt.hi: Ek L-shape ke kamre ko do alag tareekon se do rectangles mein baanta ja sakta hai. Guess karo: kya dono tareekon se same area aayega?

challenges.hint: Does cutting a shape change how much floor there is?

prompt.en: An L-shaped room is a 10 m by 8 m rectangle with a 4 m by 3 m corner cut out. Find its area.
prompt.hi: Ek L-shape ka kamra 10 m by 8 m ka rectangle hai jiske corner se 4 m by 3 m kaat diya gaya. Area nikaalo.

prompt.en: The front wall of a hut is a 6 m wide, 4 m tall rectangle with a triangular gable on top (base 6 m, height 2 m). Find the wall's total area.
prompt.hi: Ek jhopdi ki saamne ki deewar 6 m chaudi, 4 m oonchi rectangle hai jiske upar triangle wala hissa hai (base 6 m, height 2 m). Deewar ka kul area nikaalo.

prompt.en: A 2 m wide path runs all around the outside of a 20 m by 10 m garden. Find the area of the path.
prompt.hi: 20 m by 10 m ke garden ke chaaron taraf bahar 2 m chauda raasta hai. Raaste ka area nikaalo.

prompt.en: Find the area of a trapezium with parallel sides 5 cm and 9 cm and height 4 cm.
prompt.hi: 5 cm aur 9 cm parallel sides aur 4 cm height wale trapezium ka area nikaalo.
